title: We Are Greater Than The Ultrarich
description: Turns billionaire and trillionaire fortunes into tangible, personalized, quotable comparisons.
summary: Turns billionaire and trillionaire fortunes into tangible, personalized, quotable comparisons.
offersHint: Turns billionaire and trillionaire fortunes into tangible, personalized, quotable comparisons. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.wegtultrarich.org/mcp

toolsPreview.name: duration_of_daily_spend
toolsPreview.description: How long a wealth would last if a fixed amount were spent every day. Answers "how long would it take to spend a billion dollars?"

toolsPreview.name: height_of_money_stack
toolsPreview.description: How high a wealth would stack as physical currency, across 11 currencies. No currency conversion is performed — typeOfMoney's currency overrides any symbol on wealth.

toolsPreview.name: number_of_items
toolsPreview.description: How many of one item a wealth could buy or pay off, from coffees to superyachts. Prices are approximate U.S. benchmarks in USD.

toolsPreview.name: growth_of_compound_interest
toolsPreview.description: How much a wealth grows from compound interest alone, untouched, over a period. Answers "how much does a fortune earn while its owner does nothing?"

toolsPreview.name: comparison
toolsPreview.description: Complete "them vs. you": runs one expression for both wealths and returns both results plus the ratio between them. Ideal for questions like "how does my net worth compare to a billionaire's?" A ratio.value below 1 means the user's wealth is the larger.
